claims.evidence: Witness only saw stacked tyres with tread/sidewall text partially visible; no clear brand/model or import/"tokunbo" indicators were read.
Witness did not provide tread depth measurement or a clear way to confirm the 90% figure from the shown close-up.
No close-up evidence of inner liner/repair area was reported.
Witness did not report a full sidewall bulge check; only a stacked close-up was observed.
Witness did not read DOT/manufacturing date or any proof linking tyres to a 2023 vehicle.

risks.risk: Tyre size/fitment unknown (width/aspect/rim), which can make the tyres unusable for the buyer’s car.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the full sidewall showing the complete size marking (e.g., 205/55R16) and rim size, plus brand/model text.
risks.if_unproven: Price as unknown fitment (buyer may need to replace), assuming higher chance of mismatch.

risks.risk: Brand/model and exact variant unclear; different models have different wear and performance.
risks.proof: A photo where the brand name and full model/variant are readable on at least one tyre.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst-case generic used tyre value due to unknown model quality.

risks.risk: Tread depth/remaining life cannot be confirmed as 90%; could be significantly lower.
risks.proof: A tread depth gauge reading (or close-up showing measurable tread depth) for multiple tyres.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not meeting the claimed 90% (treat as more worn used tyres).

risks.risk: Hidden repairs/patches or internal damage not visible from the stacked exterior view.
risks.proof: Photos of the inner sidewall and inner tread surface (and any repair marks), plus a close-up of any suspicious spots.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially repaired/unknown internal condition (worst-case used condition).

risks.risk: Damage not fully checked: cuts, punctures, cracks, uneven wear, or dry rot.
risks.proof: Full circumference photos of each tyre sidewall and tread in good light, showing no cracks/bulges/cuts; include close-ups of any marks.
risks.if_unproven: Price as if damage/aging may exist (worst-case used tyre condition).

risks.risk: Tyre age/DOT date unknown; could be older than claimed even if tread looks good.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the DOT code/manufacturing date on the sidewall for each tyre.
risks.if_unproven: Price as older used tyres (age risk) until DOT is shown.

risks.risk: Quantity and whether all tyres are the same size/model unknown; mismatched sets reduce value.
risks.proof: A photo showing the total number of tyres included and that each tyre has the same size/model markings.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a mixed/uncertain set (worst-case for matching).

proof_requests: Clear photo of the full sidewall markings (complete size like 205/55R16) and brand/model text for at least one tyre.
Tread depth gauge readings (or close-up with measurable tread depth) for multiple tyres.
Photos of inner sidewall and any repair/patch areas (if any).
Full-circumference photos of each tyre showing no cuts, punctures, cracks, bulges, or uneven wear.
Clear photo of DOT/manufacturing date code for each tyre.
Photo showing the total number of tyres and confirmation that all are the same size/model.
response.reason: The witness confirms tyres are present, but key pricing drivers (exact size/brand/model, DOT/age, and measurable tread depth) are not readable or provided. Without those, a worst-case price would be unreliable; request the missing shots to price correctly in Oyo.
